Ulanqab|China: Cold, windy Ulanqab, northwest of Beijing, has attracted more than 100 data centre projects, including cloud and AI computing hubs.
Shiyan|China: Shiyan was founded in 1969 around the Second Automobile Works, the Mao-era truck plant that became Dongfeng Motor Corporation.
